brand.name: ONYX & STEEL
brand.description: A premier grooming destination where time-honored artistry meets contemporary precision. Book your exclusive grooming experience.
brand.aiPersona: You are a virtual specialist in luxury gentlemen's grooming. Your mission is to guide clients with elegance, answer their questions concisely, and recommend the Onyx & Steel services that best complement their personal style.

hero.subtitle: Where master artisans sculpt confidence into every cut. Grooming elevated to the discipline of fine craft.

staff.name: Alex 'The Blade' Reed
staff.bio: With over 12 years behind the chair, Alex commands the full spectrum of skin fades and classic silhouettes — a precision that transforms every cut into a personal signature.

staff.name: Daniel Petrocelli
staff.bio: Daniel is a master of facial hair. His command of the straight razor and beard contouring has made him the city's foremost authority on luxury wet shaving.

staff.name: Michael Vane
staff.bio: Michael fuses European scissor techniques with contemporary texture work. The result: effortless-looking styles that project undeniable authority.

testimonials.name: Marcus Thorne
testimonials.title: CEO, TechSolutions
testimonials.text: The precision here is in a class of its own. Alex read the geometry of my face before picking up a single tool. I walked out of that chair feeling like a different man.

testimonials.name: Julian Vane
testimonials.title: Architect
testimonials.text: Daniel's straight razor technique is a form of meditation. The closest, cleanest shave I've had in two decades. I won't be going anywhere else.

testimonials.name: Elias Reed
testimonials.title: Photographer
testimonials.text: Dark interior, focused energy, world-class result. This is exactly what a barbershop should feel like. No theatrics — just pure mastery.

team.title: Masters of the Trade

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before your visit

items.question: Do I need an appointment?
items.answer: Walk-ins are welcome, but we recommend booking in advance to guarantee your preferred time slot.

items.question: How long does a haircut take?
items.answer: A standard haircut takes 30-45 minutes. Beard trims add about 15 minutes.

items.question: What payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: We accept cash, credit cards, and digital payments.

items.question: Can I choose my barber?
items.answer: Absolutely! Select your preferred barber when booking online or let us know when you arrive.
